name: California DMV
sub: New rules open AV trucking and transit in California from Jul 2026
about: Regulates AV testing and driverless deployment permits on California roads. April 2026 rules opened California roads to heavy-duty AV testing above 10,001 lbs for the first time and, from July 1, let law enforcement cite AV companies directly.
metrics: Maintains autonomous vehicle permit regime and disengagement reporting
signal: New rules authorize AV trucks/transit, allow tickets (eff. Jul 2026)
